narrative: During the week of March 23–29, 2026, President Donald Trump issued a single executive order, EO 14397, titled "Further Continuance of the Federal Emergency Management Agency Review Council." This order focused on extending the role of a federal advisory committee tasked with overseeing FEMA’s emergency management functions, reflecting ongoing delegation of authority to support preparedness and response efforts.

orders.title: Further Continuance of the Federal Emergency Management Agency Review Council
